entries.german: Eberhard von Menzingen, Ritter, und seine Frau Ela von Rosenberg verkaufen ihre Güter zu Großgartach an Kloster Odenheim um 750 fl.
entries.english: Eberhard von Menzingen, Ritter, and his wife Ela von Rosenberg sold their properties in Großgartach to Odenheim Monastery for 750 florins.

facts.content: sold their property in Großgartach to Odenheim Abbey jointly with her husband Eberhard von Menzingen, Ritter.
